item.title: Gobblin Gobbles Prime Ministership
item.description: In what came as a shock result to some, the UPP received a nearly immediate win in the first round of voting with 14 votes, leading to a 15 vote win in the second round.

item.title: Prime Minister Resigns
item.description: In a surprising turn of events, Cissonius has today announced his immediate resignation from the post of Prime Minister, a development that has surprised many political pundits and the reasoning is nothing short of curious.
